name: Fidelity USD Digital Liquidity Fund-Acc
oneLiner: FILQ-A is Fidelity International's accumulating dollar money-market fund share, with credit and derivative permissions and redemption-only exit.
collateral: Participating shares in Fidelity International Strategies Funds SPC's USD Digital Liquidity Fund SP. The July 31, 2026 factsheet reports commercial paper 49.2%, certificates of deposit 25.1%, time deposits 17.6% and cash 8.0% of total net assets (rounded). Securitisations, asset-backed commercial paper, other money-market instruments and derivatives are permitted; J.P. Morgan SE Dublin Branch is depositary/custodian.
pegMechanism: Accumulating USD money-market share priced at daily NAV; normal valuation is at 21:00 UK time, with two valuation points only during a declared stressed market environment. On-chain investors exit by redemption through the transfer agent or Token Distributor: transfers of tokens are not accepted or recognized in the register. Usual market hours are 01:00 to 21:00 London on eligible weekdays; off-hours facilities depend on liquidity, and gates or suspension may apply.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The exact deployment represents a USD short-duration money-market fund share with ordinary NAV redemption. The tbill family models the fund/NAV mechanism; it does not imply Treasury-only holdings. The share is not a wrapper of any tracked stablecoin.

notices.title: Redemption-only tokenized share
notices.message: The prospectus prohibits token transfers for on-chain investors. Redemption through the transfer agent or Token Distributor is the recognized exit, subject to liquidity gates and suspension powers.
